content: The American Heart Association (AHA) 2012 schedule outlines the coordination of television events during the conference. Open time slots are marked in red, and filming locations are to be determined. Below is a detailed breakdown of scheduled interviews and topics: Saturday, November 3, 2012 1:00 PM: Open time slot. 1:30 PM: Open time slot. 2:00 PM: Open time slot. 2:30 PM – 3:00 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Evan Stein Topic: Interim results from the GAUSS study, which evaluated goal achievement after the use of an anti-PCSK9 antibody in statin-intolerant subjects. This was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study. Embargo lift: Monday, November 5, 2012. 3:00 PM – 3:30 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Elizabeth A. Magnuson Topic: Cost-effectiveness of PCI with drug-eluting stents versus bypass surgery in patients with diabetes and multi-vessel coronary artery disease, based on results from the FREEDOM trial. Embargo lift: Sunday, November 4, 2012, at 6:12 PM. 3:30 PM – 4:30 PM: Interviewees: Dr. Paul Gurbel and Dr. Magnus Ohman Topic: The first large-scale platelet function evaluation in acute coronary syndromes, specifically the TRILOGY ACS platelet function sub-study. Embargo lift: Sunday, November 4, 2012. 4:30 PM – 5:30 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Timothy Brighton Topic: Results of the ASPIRE randomized controlled trial, which investigated aspirin for the prevention of recurrent venous thromboembolism after a first unprovoked event. Embargo lift: Sunday, November 4, 2012. Sunday, November 4, 2012 8:00 AM: Open time slot. 8:30 AM: Open time slot. 9:00 AM: Open time slot. 11:30 AM: Open time slot. 1:00 PM – 1:30 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Bradley A. Bart Topic: Results of the CARRESS-HF study, which focused on cardiorenal rescue in acute decompensated heart failure, conducted by the Heart Failure Clinical Research Network. Embargo lift: Tuesday, November 6, 2012, at 5:13 PM. 2:00 PM: Open time slot. Monday, November 5, 2012 7:30 AM – 8:00 AM: Interviewee: Dr. Valentin Fuster Topic: Main results of the FREEDOM trial, which evaluated optimal management of multivessel disease in patients with diabetes mellitus. Embargo lift: Sunday, November 4, 2012. 8:00 AM – 8:30 AM: Interviewee: Dr. Stephen Wiviott Topic: The TRILOGY ACS angiographic cohort, a prospective, randomized trial comparing prasugrel versus clopidogrel in medically managed patients with non-ST-segment elevation ACS after coronary angiography. 8:30 AM – 9:00 AM: Interviewee: Dr. Eric L. Eisenstein Topic: Economic outcomes of percutaneous coronary intervention performed at sites with and without on-site cardiac surgery. Embargo lift: Sunday, November 4, 2012. 9:00 AM: Open time slot. 9:30 AM: Open time slot. 10:00 AM – 10:30 AM: Interviewee: Dr. Jay H. Traverse Topic: The effect of timing of stem cell delivery following acute myocardial infarction, based on the NHLBI and CCTRN TIME trial. Embargo lift: Tuesday, November 6, 2012, at 12:00 PM. 10:30 AM – 11:00 AM: Interviewees: Dr. Daniel Sürder and Dr. Roberto Corti Topic: Results of the Swiss Multicenter Intracoronary Stem Cells Study in Acute Myocardial Infarction (Swiss AMI) trial. Embargo lift: Tuesday, November 6, 2012. 11:00 AM – 11:30 AM: Interviewee: Dr. Renato Lopes Topic: AHA wrap-up in Portuguese. 1:30 PM: Open time slot. 2:00 PM: Open time slot. Tuesday, November 6, 2012 8:30 AM – 9:00 AM: Interviewee: Dr. Paul Armstrong Topic: AHA wrap-up from a Canadian perspective. 9:00 AM – 9:30 AM: Interviewee: Dr. Thomas R. Porter Topic: Prospective evaluation of outcomes with stress perfusion imaging versus stress wall motion imaging during dobutamine or exercise echocardiography. Embargo lift: Sunday, November 4, 2012. 9:30 AM – 10:00 AM: Interviewee: Dr. Gregory G. Schwartz Topic: Effects of the cholesteryl ester transfer protein inhibitor dalcetrapib in patients with recent acute coronary syndrome. Embargo lift: Monday, November 5, 2012, at 12:00 PM. 10:00 AM – 10:30 AM: Interviewee: Dr. Frederick J. Raal Topic: Interim results from the RUTHERFORD trial, a phase 2 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study on LDL-C reduction with PCSK9 inhibition in heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia. Embargo lift: Monday, November 5, 2012. 1:00 PM – 1:30 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Hisao Ogawa Topic: AHA wrap-up in Japanese. 1:30 PM: Open time slot. 2:00 PM: Open time slot. This schedule provides a comprehensive overview of the interviews and topics to be covered during the AHA 2012 conference, with embargo times specified for the release of study results.
